acceptanceCriteria: Cargo workspace package versions、Cargo.lock 和当前三语发布/版本文档一致为 0.2.99，历史版本保持不变。
v0.2.99 使用未占用的不可变 annotated tag，并绑定本次审查过的 main 源提交。
provider Release 为稳定公开状态，manifest、checksums、SBOM、archives、attestation 和 source identity 互相绑定。
从公开不可变 Release 下载的 x86_64 产物通过 checksum、隔离 fresh-install、v0.2.98 到 v0.2.99 升级以及精确临时目录清理；对象仓库不发生写入。
Outcome 以当前中文对话语言完整交付，明确完成内容、验证范围、剩余未知和下一步；性能收益保持未知，宿主展示确认保持未知。
goal: 从最新已审查 main 创建 v0.2.99 候选，完成不可变标签、稳定 provider Release、完整发布产物与供应链证据、下载产物安装/升级验收、发布后清理和最终中文 Outcome；不修改对象仓库。
intent: 完成 Outcome 语言修复、四方向收敛和 Issue #851 对应后的最终 v0.2.99 发布
outOfScope: 不修改对象仓库主分支或合并对象仓库；不重跑已完成的功能 WI；不宣称性能提速；不宣称宿主已展示或用户已阅读 Outcome；不新增生命周期协议或发布系统。

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run version consistency before publication and compare the peeled remote tag with the reviewed release source commit

scenarioCoverage.expected: Provider Release is stable and its manifest, checksums, SBOM, archives, attestation, and handoff bind to v0.2.99
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Consume the release workflow handoff and validate provider Release assets independently

scenarioCoverage.expected: Downloaded v0.2.99 installs in isolated roots and upgrades the public v0.2.98 baseline with exact cleanup
scenarioCoverage.scenario: downloaded fresh install and N-1 upgrade
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the hosted adopter and upgrade acceptance receipts, then validate cleanup bindings

scenarioCoverage.expected: ORG-X, sentinel, goods-garden, and ai-investigation-orchestrator have no changes
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect their HEAD and status before and after release operations

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run documentation acceptance and parity status checks before and after publication

scope: 更新 workspace package 版本与当前三语发布/版本文档；执行现有 release.yml 的受治理发布路径；采集并绑定 tag、Release、manifest、checksums、SBOM、archives、attestation、安装、升级、版本一致性与清理 receipt；归档并关闭本 WI。
